title: Outdoor Holding Company Appoints Director of AI Strategy & Implementation
summary: Atlanta, GA., June 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Outdoor Holding Company (Nasdaq: POWW, POWWP) (“OHC,” “we,” “us,” “our” or the “Company”), the owner of GunBroker.com , the largest online marketplace for firearms, hunting and related products, today announced the appointment of Erich Buerger as Director of AI Strategy Implementation. In this newly created role, Mr. Buerger will lead the development, coordination, and execution of artificial intelligence initiatives across the Company. The appointment reflects OHC’s commitment to deploying artificial intelligence in disciplined, high-value ways that enhance marketplace functionality, operational efficiency, and long-term shareholder value.
